walkthrough.heading: How to help document your photo
walkthrough.intro: These are your photos from the event. For each one, fill in what you know. Not everything is required. Names, places, dates, and a short story are the most valuable - anything you write helps the archive hold them properly.
walkthrough.detailsSummary: What each box is for (open if helpful)
items: People (left to right) - names + how they relate to you (e.g., "Margaret Lapointe, mother").
Location - town, community, reserve, or region (e.g., "Winnipeg - St. Boniface").
Approx. year / era - anything that helps: "around 1952", "early 1940s", "before the flood".
Occasion - harvest, wedding, church gathering, meeting, school day.
Story - a few sentences about what was happening and why it matters.
Caption - a short line describing the image (what future readers should see).
Attribution / credit - "photo by me" or leave blank.
